## Overview

A roguelite deckbuilding RPG about a fish trying to pay off debt in an underwater city, built with Excalibur.js (game engine) + Svelte 5 (UI overlay). Inspired by Slay the Spire (combat, map, relics) and Cross Blitz (world, charm).

## Locked Decisions

- D1: **MVP = full roguelike run** — procedural map with branching paths, shops, rest sites, relics, boss encounter at the end. One playable fish character to start.
- D2: **No enemy intent display** — enemies follow attack patterns; player reads behavior to react.
- D3: **Fixed 3 energy/turn** — baseline 3 energy, card effects can increase it temporarily.
- D4: **Card types** — Attack (damage), Skill (block/buff/debuff), Power (persistent effect).
- D5: **Canvas + Svelte overlay** — Excalibur renders game world (characters, enemies, effects, map nodes); Svelte renders UI chrome (HUD, cards, menus).
- D6: **IndexedDB** persistence for run save and meta-progress.
- D7: **Debt/finance theme** — underwater city, fish character, cards as financial instruments.

## Requirements

### Functional Requirements

- FR-1: Player starts a run by selecting a fish character
- FR-2: Procedurally generated branching map with nodes (combat, elite, shop, rest, boss)
- FR-3: Turn-based combat using Excalibur.js — player draws 5 cards per turn, spends 3 energy
- FR-4: Deckbuilding — player adds cards to deck after combat, can remove at shops
- FR-5: Cards: Attack (damage), Skill (block, buff, debuff), Power (persistent buff)
- FR-6: Enemy AI — simple attack patterns (fixed rotation or conditional)
- FR-7: Blocking — player plays block cards to reduce incoming damage this turn
- FR-8: Win condition: defeat the boss at the end of the map
- FR-9: Lose condition: player HP reaches 0
- FR-10: Relic system — permanent buffs obtained from elites, bosses, shops, events
- FR-11: Rest sites — heal HP or upgrade a card
- FR-12: Shop — buy cards (remove from pool), remove cards from deck
- FR-13: Meta-progression — unlocks persist between runs (new cards, relics, characters)
- FR-14: Run save/load via IndexedDB
- FR-15: Svelte UI: main menu, battle HUD, hand viewer, deck viewer, map screen, relic inventory
- FR-16: MVP: 1 playable fish character, ~40 cards, ~8 enemies, 3 acts + final boss

- NFR-2: Runs entirely in browser (no server needed)
- NFR-3: Responsive to 1366x768 minimum viewport

- [ ] AC-1: Player can start a new run from main menu
- [ ] AC-2: Procedural map generates with valid branching paths
- [ ] AC-3: Player navigates map, enters combat nodes
- [ ] AC-4: Combat plays correctly — draw cards, spend energy, play cards, enemies act
- [ ] AC-5: Deck persists through run — cards added after combat, removable at shop
- [ ] AC-6: Block reduces incoming damage correctly
- [ ] AC-7: Relics apply permanent buffs for the run
- [ ] AC-8: Rest site lets player heal or upgrade a card
- [ ] AC-9: Boss fight at map end — win = run complete, lose = run over
- [ ] AC-10: Meta-progress unlocks persist between runs
- [ ] AC-11: Run can be saved and resumed via IndexedDB

**Given** the player starts a new run with the default fish character
**When** they navigate the procedural map, fight enemies, collect cards and relics, visit shops and rest sites
**Then** they reach and defeat the final boss
**And** the run completes with score summary
**And** meta-progress is updated

**And** the player can start a new run

**When** they close the browser tab
**And** return later
**Then** the run state is restored from IndexedDB
**And** they resume from the same position

## Card Data Model

```typescript
interface CardDef {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'attack' | 'defense' | 'equipment' | 'recruit';
  cost: number;           // Resources needed to play
  pitchValue: 1 | 2 | 3; // Resources gained when pitched
  attack: number;         // Damage when played offensively
  defense: number;        // Damage blocked when used defensively
  keywords?: Keyword[];
  effects?: Effect[];
  description: string;
  recruitDeck?: string[]; // For recruit cards — ally's deck to merge
  allyHp?: number;        // HP when summoned to grid
  allyAttack?: number;    // Attack when summoned to grid
}
```

**Resource/pitch flow:**
- Playing a card costing 3: pitch cards from hand totaling ≥3 pitch value → cards go to bottom of deck → play the card
- Overdraft: if you have only 2 resources and play a 4-cost card, resources become -2
- Repayment: next turn, before spending, you must pitch cards until resources ≥ 0

## Turn Flow

```
PLAYER TURN:
1. Draw hand to maxHand (4 for Guppy)
2. Repay overdraft: must pitch until resources ≥ 0 (if in debt)
3. Optional: pitch more cards from hand for additional resources
4. Play attack cards: spend resources, target enemy grid slot or hero
5. Attacks resolve
6. Pass to enemy

ENEMY TURN:
1. Enemy draws and plays attacks
2. PLAYER DEFENSE: discard cards from hand to block (use defense value)
3. Unblocked damage hits grid units → hero (if front row clear)
4. Damage applied, units may die
5. Next player turn
```

## Combat Flow

```
PLAYER TURN:
1. Draw hand to maxHand (4 for Guppy)
2. Start with 0 coins
3. Player actions (any order, any number):
   a. SELL card → goes to sellPile (ordered at end of turn) → gain coins = coinValue
   b. PLAY attack card → costs coins (can go negative to -credit limit) → click enemy target → deal damage + resolve effects + keywords
4. End turn → if sellPile has cards → prompt to order them → cards go to bottom of deck
5. If coins < 0 → take interest damage = |debt|
6. Coins reset to 0

ENEMY TURN:
1. Each alive enemy gets an action from EnemyAI (attack/defend based on strategy)
2. Show intent per enemy (DMG or DEF value)
3. Player blocks: select cards from hand to discard for defense value
4. Unblocked damage hits hero
5. Dead enemies removed, check victory/defeat
6. Next player turn

DECK CYCLE: battleDeck (copy of run deck) — sold cards go to bottom, played/blocked cards to battleDiscard. When empty, shuffle discard back.
```
